description: This Java source file defines the AttributesNotAccessibleException class, which is a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that attributes of a specific 'Thing' could not be accessed, either due to non-existence or insufficient permissions. It includes methods for constructing the exception from messages or JSON objects, and supports fluent builder pattern for customization.

classes.name: AttributesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A custom, immutable exception class indicating that attributes of a particular 'Thing' were inaccessible, either not found or lacking permissions, with built-in support for constructing instances from messages or JSON representations.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing an AttributesNotAccessibleException, initializing it with the given ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an AttributesNotAccessibleException from a provided message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an AttributesNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and headers, parsing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with updated DittoHeaders.
